description: Latest crypto news from CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block and Bitcoin Magazine, merged and ranked: the same story covered by several outlets is grouped and ranked higher, newer stories rank higher. Each article has title, source, URL, publish time, 300-character summary, mentioned tickers and which outlets covered it. Filter by coins (tickers) or keywords. Params: coins (e.g. ['BTC','ETH']), query (keywords), hours (lookback 1 to 168, default 48), limit (1 to 50, default 20), sources. Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"coins":["BTC","ETH"],"limit":10}.
